name: autotriage
description: GitHub Action for AI-assisted issue and pull request triage using a repository-defined prompt.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run clean && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --minify --legal-comments=eof --outfile=dist/index.js
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:test && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:dist

author: Daniel Chalmers
